summary: Simone Brunozzi, based in San Francisco, technology evangelist at Amazon Web Services, former barista, experienced public speaker with over 500 talks, strong advocate for effective teaching methods, Italian heritage, beekeeping enthusiast, critical of American food quality compared to Italian cuisine, frequent traveler with extensive flight experience, engaged in discussions about social issues and technology, supportive of startups and innovation, interested in public transportation improvements, and has a family structure that includes a father he values.
